Accuracy class (I) or (II)
Maximum capacity Class I Max ≤ 20,1 kg
Class II Max ≤ 64,1 kg
Verification scale interval Class I e ≥ 1 mg
Class II e ≥ 10 mg
Actual scale interval Class I e = d, or e = 2 d, or e = 10 d, or e = 20 d, or e = 50 d,
or e = 100 d, or e = 200d, or e = 500d, or e = 1000d,

'1' represents the legally relevant software part(s)
